# ankra_mcp_servers (Data Source)

Lists the organisation's MCP tool servers. The counterpart of `ankra org mcp-servers list`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ankra_mcp_servers" "all" {}

output "enabled_servers" {
  value = [for server in data.ankra_mcp_servers.all.servers : server.name if server.enabled]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Placeholder identifier for the data source.
- `servers` (Attributes List) Registered servers. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))

<a id="nestedatt--servers"></a>
### Nested Schema for `servers`

Read-Only:

- `adapter_key` (String) Curated adapter, if any.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether agent runs may use it.
- `id` (String) Server id.
- `last_error` (String) Last connection error, if any.
- `name` (String) Server name.
- `permission_tier` (String) `read_only` or `read_write`.
- `tool_grants_count` (Number) Number of tool grants.
- `transport` (String) `http`, `sse` or `stdio`.
